instruction: You are given a template with completed modal analysis `/home/user/Desktop/ssd_base.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. First submit modal analysis to generate `ssd_modal.eig`. 2. Write frequency-response input `/home/user/Desktop/ssd.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/ssd.inp. - Use `*Steady State Dynamics`, frequency range `1-100 Hz`, `20` points - Apply `FY=100 N` at node 2 (harmonic force, real part) - Constrain the fixed end 3. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `ssd.dat`: - Extract response amplitude near `33.42 Hz` (first natural frequency) - Extract peak frequency and peak displacement - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `peak_freq_hz, peak_uy_mm` [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal.
